subject: Finest surface sampling the camera reaches on Ceres, against the texel sizes of the candidate Dawn FC mosaics
method: For each viewport width W from 320 to 2560 CSS px (step 10), the camera stops at the larger of two distances from Ceres' centre: the prepared floor dolly.minimumDistanceRadii x R, and the distance at which the silhouette radius equals maximumZoom / framingReferenceZoom x logicalBodyDiameter / 2 (distanceForSilhouetteRadius in packages/renderer/src/navigation/prepared-camera.ts, on axis). The focal length is focalLengthOverViewportWidth x W. One CSS pixel at the point below the camera covers altitude / focal km; the app draws two texels per CSS pixel, so the texel it can show is half that. framingReferenceZoom is computed for both 1.0 (the shared world context) and 1.1 (the body's defaultZoom fallback).
inputsFrom: src/objects/ceres/prepared/object.json data.camera (restored runtime, 2026-09-28) and src/objects/ceres/object.json shape.radiusKm
atlasNote: current4096 is the shipped Monochrome atlas: public/scenes/ceres/ceres-normal@2x.webp is 4160 x 3072 with a 32-texel gutter, 4096 texels around the equator, 3,887,406 bytes (inventory.json).
